description: The Renovate policy every CEDAR backend repository shares: review-only pull requests against develop after a fourteen-day release age, majors only on approval, and no move of an internal CEDAR version or of the locked Java release. A repository extends it with local>metadatacenter/cedar-parent:renovate-backend and adds only the rules that are its own.

packageRules.description: Use the CEDAR Nexus pull-through proxy so hosted Renovate is not exposed to Maven Central's shared-IP rate limit.
Never rewrite the CEDAR reactor/train version or another internal CEDAR artifact.
Major platform upgrades require an explicit operator decision in the Dependency Dashboard.

Java is locked to 17, as the cedar-parent enforcer requires. Renovate reads the version from actions/setup-java in CI; moving it is an estate-wide change to the profile, CI, enforcer and runtime image together.
Every repository carries its own Maven wrapper, and moving Maven is one change across all of them, made just after a release. The dashboard offers it; nothing opens it unasked.
Keep a repository's workflow action updates in one pull request.
